hero_eyebrow: A living heritage. A continent of stories.
about_heading: A story of history, identity, culture, memory and belonging.
about_paragraph_1: Across the African continent and its diaspora are stories of Jewish communities, ancient connections, traditions, journeys and lived experiences that deserve to be remembered, documented and celebrated.
about_paragraph_2: The African Jewish Heritage Centre is a space dedicated to preserving and reclaiming overlooked histories and restoring the richness of African Jewish heritage to the wider historical narrative.
about_paragraph_3: Through research, oral histories, cultural preservation, education and community engagement, we bring the past into conversation with the present, creating a living legacy for future generations.
explore_intro: Discover the people, communities, histories, traditions and journeys that form part of the history of the Jewish people in Africa.
map_quote: “I saw two of them in Egypt. They are dark-skinned... and one could not tell whether they keep the teaching of the Karaites, or of the Rabbis, for some of their practices resemble the Karaite teaching... but in other things, they appear to follow the instruction of the Rabbis; and they say they are related to the tribe of Dan.”
watch_intro: Discover African Jewish heritage through films, interviews, conversations and first-hand accounts.

share_intro: Every family holds memories. Every community has a history. Every photograph, letter, object and personal account can help preserve a part of our collective heritage.
programmes_intro: Preserving heritage. Inspiring leadership. Building the future.

programme_2_description: Documenting histories through research, oral histories, photography and community knowledge.
programme_3_description: Creating opportunities to engage with heritage and develop leadership skills.
programme_4_description: Building relationships and spaces for cultural exchange and shared learning.
